message.content: { "drugs": [ { "generic": "azithromycin", "plain_purpose": "an antibiotic that treats mild to moderate bacterial infections such as bronchitis, sinusitis, and skin infections", "common_side_effects": ["diarrhea", "nausea", "abdominal pain", "vomiting"], "key_warning": "can cause severe allergic reactions, liver damage, and abnormal heart rhythms" }, { "generic": "acetaminophen", "plain_purpose": "a medicine that relieves minor aches, pains, and reduces fever", "common_side_effects": [], "key_warning": "taking more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours or drinking alcohol can cause severe liver damage" }, { "generic": "metformin", "plain_purpose": "a diabetes medicine that helps control blood sugar when used with diet and exercise", "common_side_effects": ["diarrhea", "nausea or vomiting", "gas", "stomach discomfort"], "key_warning": "rare but serious risk of lactic acidosis, a buildup of acid in the blood that can be fatal" }, { "generic": "atorvastatin", "plain_purpose": "a cholesterol-lowering medicine that reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke", "common_side_effects": ["cold symptoms", "joint pain", "diarrhea", "muscle pain"], "key_warning": "can cause serious muscle damage, especially in older adults or those with kidney problems" }, { "generic": "aspirin", "plain_purpose": "a medicine that relieves minor aches and pains", "common_side_effects": [], "key_warning": "children and teenagers with flu or chickenpox should not take it because of Reye's syndrome risk" } ] }
